questions.question: Who was appointed as the Chief of the Indian Research and Analysis Wing (RAW) in June 2019?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Samant Goel.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64e177b3c5c5cb81c12b3d5b5ddabaaf474cdad3d6098992ca6592786c8147d6.png] 

 
• 
 **Samant Goel** was appointed as the **Chief of the Indian Research and Analysis Wing (RAW)** in June 2019.
 
 
• 
 He has been appointed for a fixed tenure of **two years.**
 
 
• 
 He is a **1984 batch IPS officer** of the Punjab cadre.
 
 
• 
 He had **joined the RAW in 2001** and possesses rich experience in intelligence and operations.
 

 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87c1a28e731fadd9279228c1cea2f8e988a3f790bf9ccc89c9b0f02c423b1609.png] 

**RAW (Research and Analysis Wing)**

 
• The Research and Analysis Wing (RAW) was **founded in 1968 **to counter primarily China & Pakistan.
 
• Until **1968, the Intelligence Bureau (IB),** was responsible for India’s internal intelligence and external intelligence.
 
• After the **poor performance of Indian intelligence i**n the war of 1962 against China and 1965 against Pakistan, the government felt the need for a separate external intelligence agency.
 
• **RAW provides intelligence to policymakers and the army**.
 
• Raw keeps **close eyes on the activities of the neighboring countries **(China, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, etc.) of India.
 
• The primary focus of RAW remains on** China and Pakistan.**

questions.question: In 2018, Bharat Vatwani and _________ were the two Indians awarded with the Ramon Magsaysay award.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1, i.e. Sonam Wangchuk.

• The Ramon Magsaysay Award is often referred to as the Asian version of the Nobel Prize.
 
• Sonam Wangchuk, a mechanical engineer/scientist has revolutionized the teaching methods in the hilly areas of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladhak.
 
• His speciality includes coming up with low-cost solutions to modern-day problems with minimal resources but the highest efficiency.
 
• A character named "Phunsukh Wangdu" in the film " 3 Idiots" is inspired by him.
 
• __Wangchuk __builds Ice Stupas to facilitate irrigation in the desert areas of the western Himalayas.
 
• In 1988, he founded SECMOL (Students’ Educational and Cultural Movement of Ladakh).
 
• This school especially teaches only those students who have failed in their exams and not even those who score fewer marks.
 
• 
 
Ramon Magsaysay Award was awarded to him in the year 2018. (considered the Nobel Prize in the East)

questions.question: The famous Madhubani artist who won the Bihar Ratna in 1984 is ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Sita Devi__.**

 
• Sita Devi was one of the most prominent early Mithila artists.
 
• She was among the first to transfer the traditional art form from the walls of the home to paper and canvas from the village of **Jitwarpur, Bihar**.
 
• She popularized the** ‘Bharni’ style** of Mithila painting, which emphasizes strong colours over fine lines.
 
• In **1975**, she won a **National Award.**
 
• In **1981 **she was awarded the** Padma Shri**, one of India’s highest civilian honours.
 
• In **1984** won the **Bihar Ratna Samman**.
 
• During her career, she exhibited her work in more than ten countries.
 
• Her art is present in the permanent collections of the Victoria & Albert Museum in London, the Los Angeles County Museum of Art, the Philadelphia Museum of Art, the Musée du Quai Branly in Paris, the** Mithila Museum in Japan** and many other international institutions.
 
• **Madhubani painting** is one of the many famous Indian art forms.
 
• As it is practised in the Mithila region of Bihar and Nepal, it is called** Mithila **or Madhubani art.
